pr_title: Refactor multiplayer/playlist polling out of RoomManager
pr_body:
Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/14135

This moves the polling to wherever required.

For playlists:
- Listing in lounge
- Selection in room

For multiplayer:
- Listing in lounge

The eventual next step is to remove the `Bindable<Room>`, which this structure makes easier to do.
pr_comments:
> Applying the following patch appears to fix:

In regards to this... The rooms stored in that class are the server-side rooms, so it'd be incorrect to call `AddOrUpdateRoom()`. I've refactored it a bit to make this more explicit, since it's the second time it's come up.
@smoogipoo I've made a few changes - please take a quick look. looks good otherwise 👍 .

issue_context.title: Selected room polling should be removed from multiplayer
issue_context.body:
In multiplayer, the selected room's state is controlled via the multiplayer server once joined:
https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/acbdae3c4cfdb12a7d89d956b76e1269e9474a22/osu.Game/Screens/OnlinePlay/Multiplayer/Multiplayer.cs#L46-L50

And in the lounge, the selected room polling is only used to populate the recent participants list, which will eventually be included as part of the larger listing poll with https://github.com/ppy/osu-web/issues/7972.

In effect - we should be able to remove the selected room polling from multiplayer altogether, and keep only the listing request. It should remain for playlists because it keeps the room updated while joined.

review_comments: `CreateRoom` still invokes the `RoomsUpdated` event directly without the manager's scheduler, is that intentional?
I would say so? I think this debounce is to prevent firing the event every time for each updated room, no? While it's probably best that create fires immediately for consistency reasons.

With that being said, I can remove this with future work. It's only used in one place, which is to update the sorting in the lounge based on the `Position` variable. But I believe that variable can be removed (I already updated it to be the negative of `RoomId` in this PR, which is always constant).
I'm guessing this can be superseded wholesale by sorting by decreasing `ID` for all intents and purposes in a separate pull?

This indirectly breaks `AddRooms()`, because that method always uses room IDs of `0..(count - 1)`, which in turn breaks `TestSceneLoungeRoomsContainer.TestRulesetFiltering` (the catch rooms added therein overwrite the osu! rooms).
Should this call have been removed?

`AddOrUpdate` slightly feels too long compared to `Remove` and the rest, there's the term [`Upsert`](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/upsert) from googling around, but feels too special to use here, not sure... thoughts?

The current name is fine. There's precedent in official .NET API ([`ConcurrentDictionary`](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.collections.concurrent.concurrentdictionary-2.addorupdate?view=net-5.0#System_Collections_Concurrent_ConcurrentDictionary_2_AddOrUpdate__0_System_Func__0__1__System_Func__0__1__1__)).
